картина: PDF-модель-карточка Gemini 2.5 Flash с нативными возможностями (аудио и изображение), обновлена в декабре 2025. Большая часть — текстовая модель 2.5 Flash: гибридный reasoning (thinking вкл/выкл, бюджеты), входы (текст/изображения/аудио/видео, 1M), архитектура MoE, методика и таблица текстовых бенчмарков, безопасность (с таблицей текстовых оценок). Про генерацию изображений: 2.5 Flash Image = image-выход 2.5 Flash, лимит 32K токенов, методика оценки (GenAI-Bench, LMArena), две таблицы Elo (T2I: 3 строки; Editing: 7 строк) против Imagen 4 Ultra, GPT Image 1, FLUX.1 Kontext, Qwen Image Edit, Gemini Flash 2.0 Image (на август 2025), #1 LMArena на 25.08.2025, назначение (консистентность персонажей/стиля, редактирование промптом, знания о мире, high-res редактирование, multi-image fusion), ограничения (длинный текст, фактические мелкие детали), knowledge cutoff январь 2025.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash is described as Google's first fully hybrid reasoning model: developers can turn thinking on or off and set thinking budgets to trade off quality, cost, and latency.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini 2.5 Flash is Google’s first fully
hybrid reasoning model, giving developers the ability to turn a model’s thinking on or off. The
model also allows developers to set thinking budgets to find the right tradeoff between quality,
cost, and latency.
единицы.раздел: Model Information — Description
единицы.заметка: Сказано про Gemini 2.5 Flash; применимость thinking к image-выходу (2.5 Flash Image) в карточке не уточнена.

additional outputs of Gemini 2.5 Flash; information specific to these modalities is specified in line
(i.e. ‘Gemini 2.5 Flash Image’, 'Gemini 2.5 Flash Audio'). Deployment status continues to be “general
availability.”

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image was evaluated with human evaluations of text-to-image quality aspects (overall preference, prompt-image alignment, visual appeal) and automatic metrics for prompt-image alignment and image quality.
единицы.цитата:
Approach: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image was evaluated using the methodology below:

       ●​ Human evaluations of several different quality aspects of text-to-image generation were
          conducted, including overall preference, prompt-image alignment and visual appeal.
          Automatic evaluation metrics were used to measure prompt-image alignment and image
          quality.
единицы.раздел: Evaluation — Gemini 2.5 Flash Image — Approach

единицы.утверждение_en: Human evaluations used GenAI-Bench and LMArena: text-to-image (Overall Preference, Visual Quality, Text-to-Image Alignment) and image editing (Character, Creative, Infographics, Object/Environment, Product Recontextualization, Stylization).
единицы.цитата:
Result Sources: human evaluations were conducted via GenAI-Bench and LMArena2, including
          leaderboards reporting provider results on these benchmarks:
              ○​ Text-to-Image: Overall Preference, Visual Quality, Text-to-Image Alignment
              ○​ Image Editing: Character, Creative, Infographics, Object / Environment, Product
                   Recontextualization, and Stylization

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image provides image generation with maintained character and style consistency, prompt-based image editing, native world knowledge, editing of high-quality, high-resolution images in a wide range of visual styles, and multi-image fusion.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini 2.5 Flash Image augments Gemini 2.5 Flash’s benefits and use cases, providing image
 generation with maintained character and style consistency, prompt-based image editing, native
world knowledge, editing of high-quality, high-resolution images in a wide range of visual styles,
and multi-image fusion.
единицы.раздел: Intended Usage and Limitations — Benefit and Intended Usage

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash may show general foundation-model limitations such as hallucinations and limits in causal understanding, complex logical deduction and counterfactual reasoning; adherence to thinking budgets may not be consistent.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini 2.5 Flash may exhibit some of the general limitations of foundation
models, such as hallucinations, and limitations around causal understanding, complex logical
deduction, and counterfactual reasoning. Adherence to thinking budgets may not be consistent.

единицы.заметка: Сказано про Gemini 2.5 Flash; для image-выхода отдельно не уточнено.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash and its native capabilities were developed with internal safety, security, and responsibility teams; evaluations and red teaming align with Google's AI Principles.
единицы.цитата:
Evaluation Approach: Gemini 2.5 Flash and its native capabilities were developed in partnership
with internal safety, security, and responsibility teams. A range of evaluations and red teaming
activities were conducted to help improve the model and inform decision-making. These
evaluations and activities align with Google's AI Principles and responsible AI approach.
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Safety — Evaluation Approach

единицы.утверждение_en: Safety evaluation types included training/development evaluations, human red teaming, automated red teaming at scale, assurance evaluations by independent evaluators, and ethics & safety reviews before release; testing also followed Google DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework.
единицы.цитата:
Evaluation types included, but were not limited to:

   ●​ Training/Development Evaluations including automated and human evaluations carried
      out continuously throughout and after the model’s training, to monitor its progress and
      performance
   ●​ Human Red Teaming conducted by specialist teams across the policies and desiderata,
      deliberately trying to spot weaknesses and ensure the model adheres to safety policies
      and desired outcomes
   ●​ Automated Red Teaming to dynamically evaluate Gemini for safety and security
      considerations at scale, complementing human red teaming and static evaluations
   ●​ Assurance Evaluations conducted by human evaluators independent of the model
      development team, and assess responsibility and safety governance decisions
   ●​ Ethics & Safety Reviews were conducted ahead of the model’s release

In addition, we performed testing following the guidelines in Google DeepMind’s Frontier Safety
Framework (FSF).
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Safety — Evaluation Approach
единицы.заметка: В отличие от карточек Gemini 3: есть Automated Red Teaming.

единицы.раздел: Ethics and Safety — Safety Policies
единицы.заметка: 'make best efforts to prevent' — формулировка мягче, чем в карточках Gemini 3 ('aim to prevent'). Список — строки 393-399.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 was trained to improve instruction following while prioritizing safety and minimizing unhelpful responses; new models are more willing to engage with prompts that previous models may have incorrectly refused.
единицы.цитата:
We have focused on improving instruction following (IF) abilities of Gemini 2.5. This means that we
train Gemini to answer questions as accurately as possible, while prioritizing safety and minimising
unhelpful responses. New models are more willing to engage with prompts that previous models
may have incorrectly refused.
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Safety — Training and Development Evaluation Results
единицы.заметка: Про Gemini 2.5 (текст); для image-выхода не уточнено.

единицы.утверждение_en: Manual review found safety-eval losses were overwhelmingly false positives or non-egregious, narrowly concentrated around explicit requests for sexually suggestive or hateful content, mostly in creative use-cases (e.g. historical fiction).
единицы.цитата:
Our manual review confirmed losses were
overwhelmingly either a) false positives or b) not egregious and narrowly concentrated around
explicit requests to produce sexually suggestive content or hateful content, mostly in the context
of creative use-cases (e.g. historical fiction).
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Safety — Training and Development Evaluation Results

единицы.утверждение_en: Baseline assurance evaluations looked at behavior within safety policies and modality-specific risk areas; for content safety policies, including child safety, safety performance was similar or improved compared to Gemini 2.0 Flash.
единицы.цитата:
Assurance Evaluations Results: We conduct baseline assurance evaluations to guide decisions
on model releases. These evaluations look at model behavior, including within the context of the
safety policies and modality-specific risk areas. High-level findings are fed back to the model team.
For content safety policies, including child safety, we saw similar or improved safety performance
compared to Gemini 2.0 Flash.
единицы.раздел: Ethics and Safety — Assurance Evaluations Results
единицы.заметка: 'modality-specific risk areas' — упомянуты, но результаты по изображениям не приведены.

единицы.утверждение_en: Mitigations built into Gemini 2.5 Flash across the lifecycle include dataset filtering, conditional pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human and critic feedback, safety policies and desiderata, and product-level mitigations such as safety filtering.
единицы.цитата: product-level mitigations such as safety filtering

единицы.заметка: Цитата — последний пункт списка (строка 498); список разорван сноской 3 (строки 486-499). SynthID/C2PA не упомянуты.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: As of August 2025, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image leads every image row except Text-to-Image Alignment (Imagen 4 Ultra 1053 and GPT Image 1 1046 vs 1042) and Stylization editing (GPT Image 1 1165 and Qwen Image Edit 1091 vs 1062); its largest lead is editing Overall Preference (1362 vs 1191, +171).

The card advertises consistency, prompt-based editing, world knowledge, high-resolution editing and multi-image fusion, but names long-form text rendering and factual fine details as limitations — keep in-image text short and verify fine factual details.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Рекомендация сформулирована мной из двух разделов.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Thinking on/off and thinking budgets are described for Gemini 2.5 Flash, and all thinking-labeled benchmark columns are text benchmarks; the card never says whether the image output (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) uses or supports thinking.
The only numeric limit given for image output is a 32K-token budget; the card mentions 'high-quality, high-resolution images' but states no resolutions or aspect ratios.

противоречия_внутри: Сноска 3 говорит о 'previous iterations of the 2.5 Flash-Lite model card', хотя документ — карточка 2.5 Flash (вероятно, копипаст).
Сноска 2 (E-170-8): 2.5 Flash Image '#1 for … Image Editing', но в таблице Stylization GPT Image 1 (1165) и Qwen Image Edit (1091) выше (1062) — #1 относится к общему рейтингу, не ко всем категориям.
не_сказано: Не сказано, поддерживает ли image-выход thinking/бюджеты.
Нет результатов безопасности для генерации изображений (таблица — text-to-text, multilingual, image-to-text).
Нет максимального числа входных изображений для multi-image fusion.
